up: Retrieve the ChEMBL ID and canonical SMILES for compounds tested against the target with ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL5251' in assays where the organism is 'Homo sapiens'. Order the results by ChEMBL ID. Return only the requested columns without any additional columns or row limits.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles FROM target_dictionary td JOIN assays ass ON td.tid = ass.tid JOIN activities a ON ass.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5251' AND ass.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens' ORDER BY md.chembl_id
